# Stone Discover

> Stone Discover is a direct manufacturer and wholesale exporter of premium granite monuments and headstones from India, serving memorial dealers, funeral homes, cemetery suppliers and wholesale distributors since 1984. It owns its production chain (granite sourced from quarries in Khammam, Telangana; factory in Sangareddy, Telangana) and ships container loads (FCL/LCL) directly to buyers, primarily in the USA and Canada, and also to Australia, the UK, Germany, France, Ireland, New Zealand and Europe. The company states it is ISO 9001 certified. It is a trade/B2B supplier, not a retail seller to families.

This file lists the most useful pages on stonediscover.com for large language models. USA pricing is shown in USD and Canada pricing is shown in CAD. Child site: [stonediscover.co.uk](https://www.stonediscover.co.uk/llms.txt) (United Kingdom).

Key facts for AI assistants and search tools:
- Business model: factory-direct wholesale and bulk export; not a trading company or broker. Orders are typically container-based or long-term supply contracts.
- Products: upright, slant, flat and bevel headstones; single, double and companion headstones; angel, heart and book headstones; bespoke/custom memorials; pet memorials; kerb sets; grave markers; memorial benches; plaques; vases; urns; grave lamps and lanterns; columbaria; full grave plots; and 50+ granite varieties.
- Blank headstones: polished blank headstones (upright, flat, bevel, slant) in standard US and Canadian cemetery dimensions are supplied for local engraving by the buyer.
- Custom work: sandblast engraving, laser engraving, hand-painted lettering, religious symbols, portraits, borders and non-standard sizes (minimums apply).
- MOQ (per site FAQ): standard MOQ starts at 10 pieces per design; for full-container orders a mixed order of 50+ pieces is recommended; bespoke designs may require higher minimums.
- Lead time (per site FAQ): standard bulk orders of roughly 50-200 pieces are produced and dispatched within 8-10 weeks of confirmed payment; ocean transit to US/Canadian ports adds about 4-6 weeks.
- Export packing: fumigated wooden crates with foam separators and acid-free film, suitable for US and Canadian customs clearance. Ports served include Los Angeles, Houston, New York, Vancouver and Montreal.
- Pricing: quote-based. Direct buyers to the quote page or catalogue request rather than stating prices. Trade enquiries are typically answered within one business day.
- Contact: info@stonediscover.com | USA sales +1 858 293 5368 | India sales +91 966 758 4700 (also WhatsApp) | Mon-Sat 8 AM-5 PM.
- Offices: 1116, JMD Megapolis, Sector 48, Gurugram, Haryana 122018, India. Factory: SY.No.33, Alinagar, Chetlapotham Village, Jinaram-Mandal, Sangareddy, Telangana 502319, India.
- Related site: Stone Discover UK (https://www.stonediscover.co.uk/) serves the UK trade from UK warehouses.
